name: 市職員の給与・定年などの条例を改正
summary: 市は、一般職職員の給与や定年などに関する条例を改正する議案を提出しました。公開された原文には具体的な改正内容が記載されていないため、何が変わるかは確認できません。

en.name: Amends ordinances on city employees’ salaries and retirement age
en.official: Regarding the Partial Amendment of the Ordinance, etc. Partially Amending the Ebina City Ordinance on Salaries of Employees in General Service and the Ebina City Ordinance on Retirement Age, etc. of Employees in General Service
en.summary: The city submitted a bill to amend ordinances concerning the salaries, retirement age, and other matters of employees in general service. The published original text does not state the specific amendments, so it is not possible to confirm what will change.
